Remark
[Ricci identities] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0299 1. Section A.6\group commuting-covariant-derivatives

The commutator formulas implied by the curvature tensor are called the Ricci identities. For a vector field $X$, \[ [ abla _i, abla _j]X^\ell \equiv abla _i abla _jX^\ell - abla _j abla _iX^\ell = R^\ell {}_{ijk}X^k. \] For a covector field $ heta $, \[ [ abla _i, abla _j] heta _k \equiv abla _i abla _j heta _k- abla _j abla _i heta _k = -R^\ell {}_{ijk} heta _\ell . \]
